name: media-asset
body: Media asset: any file (font, logo, image, video, …) in the template library, addressed by its relative path within the resolved library root (`templates/media/` for a local library); type-agnostic. A layout addresses it with `{{ media "path" }}`; a theme's `theme.css` (and any CSS it imports from its own theme dir) addresses a shared asset with the reserved `media:` URL prefix, validated the same way and rewritten to the served media URL (theme-media-references).
